description: Qark activation and routing evals. Each case runs one prompt in a throwaway copy of evals/fixtures/shop-app. 'expect.skill_read' = the agent read/invoked the qark skill; 'expect.code_edits' = the agent edited or wrote a file outside .ai/. null means 'do not check'.
